# `ask` command

Answer a question from the knowledge packs (and, with --project, the project's procedures), citing sources.

```bash
fobis ask --help
```

Guide: [Asking questions](/ai/ask).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

Arguments: `QUESTION`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project`, `-p` | TEXT |  | Also search the procedures of these source directories (repeatable). |
| `--pack` | TEXT |  | Search only these packs (repeatable). |
| `-k` | INTEGER | `6` | Number of sections given to the model. |
| `--show-context` |  |  | Print what the model would receive, and stop (no model is run). |
| `--verbose` |  |  | Also print the statements dropped as uncited. |
| `--json` |  |  | Machine-readable output. |
| `--provider` | TEXT |  | managed, ollama or openai. |
| `--model`, `-m` | TEXT |  | Model (alias or spec for managed). |

<!-- cli:end -->
